newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore defence, foreign ministers on Thai visit.
newsitem.headline: Singapore defence, foreign ministers on Thai visit.

text.p: The Singapore government said on Monday two senior cabinet members, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Defence Tony Tan and Minister for Foreign Affairs S. Jayakumar, would go on official visits to Thailand this week.

In separate statements, the government said Tan's visit would reaffirm defence ties with Thailand, while Jayakumar's visit would follow-up Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh's tour of Singapore in March.
Both Singaporean ministers would meet with Chavalit, who is also Thailand's minister of defence, the statements said.

Tan's tour, which begins on Monday and ends on Thursday, would coincide with a visit by Singapore's Chief of Defence Force, Lieutenant-General Bey Soo Khiang, leading a 35-strong team in the latest of a series of bilateral exchanges.

The focus of Jayakumar's visit, beginning on Tuesday and also ending on Thursday, would be to discuss implementation of the civil service exchange programme agreed to earlier by the two countries' prime ministers.
